class.name: DialogueLocalization
class.brief_description: A dialogue resource class for multilingual dialogue support.

method.name: load
method.description:
Loads multilingual dialogue data from a JSON file. [param path]: Path to the JSON file to load (e.g., "res://dialogues/battle.json")
[codeblock] var dialogue_data = DialogueLocalization.new().load("res://dialogues/battle.json") [/codeblock]

method.name: get_dialogues
method.description:
Gets dialogue data for a specific locale (language) and ID. [param locale]: Language code [param key]: Unique identifier of the dialogue (e.g., "SANS_CALL", "Battle_Start")
Return value: - [Dialogues] object containing dialogue data for the requested locale - If the requested locale doesn't exist, uses "en" (English) - If "en" also doesn't exist, returns empty [Dialogues] object and prints error
[codeblock] # Get Korean dialogue var dialogue_ko = dialogue_data.get_dialogues("ko", "SANS_CALL")
# Get English dialogue var dialogue_en = dialogue_data.get_dialogues("en", "SANS_CALL") [/codeblock]

method.name: get_dialogues_default
method.description:
Gets dialogue data matching the system's current language settings. [param key]: Unique identifier of the dialogue
This method uses [TranslationServer] to automatically detect the current system locale.
Return value: - [Dialogues] object containing dialogue data for the current system language
[codeblock] # Automatically selects Korean dialogue if system language is Korean, English if English var dialogue = dialogue_data.get_dialogues_default("SANS_CALL")
# Use in TextBox textbox.character(false, "sans", dialogue) [/codeblock]
